# CI-only release bookkeeping and exact-head verification evidence: LOG.md / PR #27.
# 每次推送：型別與完整 Node 守衛獨立跑；單次建置後，完整瀏覽器煙霧與樣張並行。
# smoke 聚合門檻確認每一項成功；瀏覽器與樣張使用同一次建置的逐位元組相同成品。
# main 綠燈之後把 dist/index.html 發到 GitHub Pages：手機直接開網址就能看、能轉。
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'claude/**']
    paths-ignore: ['**.md', 'docs/**']
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore: ['**.md', 'docs/**']
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # CI-only split: historical Node + D078 frame + D079 frame + D080 frame equal the full Node suite.
  # Browser and screenshots retain their entire commands and acceptance limits.
  # Build once; all consumers verify the same immutable artifact ID and digest.
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    outputs:
      artifact-id: ${{ steps.artifact.outputs.artifact-id }}
      digest: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: CI provenance and fail-closed gate negative controls
        run: node --test .github/scripts/ci-integrity-d088.test.mjs tools/unit-partitions-release-v2.test.mjs
      - name: Versioned source missing/stale negatives and fresh historical receipt regression
        run: node --test tools/d082-release-source-v2.test.mjs tools/d082-historical-release.test.mjs tools/d082-release-conflicts-v2.test.mjs
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Record build source and file hashes
        id: identity
        run: node .github/scripts/ci-integrity.mjs record
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        id: artifact
        with:
          name: ci-build-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            dist/
            ci-build.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
